title: 36 Hours in Atlanta
abstract: A weekend itinerary in a city where optimism is liberally indulged and whose slogan is: “Every day is an opening day.”

title: 36 Hours in Scottsdale, Ariz.
abstract: It might be tempting a curse from the golf gods to enter the city limits without a set of clubs, but it’s easy to spend a full weekend here far from the fairways.

title: 36 Hours in Scottsdale, Ariz.
abstract: Golf, if you wish. Or eat, explore and then float in an infinity pool, contemplating your next cocktail.

title: 36 Hours in Cancún
abstract: Beyond the megahotels is a quiet, idyllic city. Another side of Cancún, Mexico, reveals itself.

title: 36 Hours in Cancún
abstract: In this Cancún, you'll find vacant shorelines, friendly women at food stands and tranquil vistas instead of wet T-shirt contests.

title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: Spend a weekend in a city that is fast-forwarding to the 21st century.

title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: As the city fast-forwards into the 21st century, Madrid remains the country’s political and cultural capital.  A weekend itinerary in “the most Spanish of all cities.”
